correctness.rationale: For even n, the Ma-Wang Kummer cover has two nonzero local exponent types, 1 and r, with unequal multiplicities q+1 and q^2-q. A normalizing automorphism must act on the Kummer eigenspaces by z -> h(u)z^t with t a unit modulo q^n+1, so it multiplies local exponents by t. Unequal multiplicities prohibit swapping the two classes, forcing t=1 and base action in PGL_2(q). Proposition 5.1 supplies every such lift, yielding the exact normalizer and centralizer; the center calculation follows from the centerlessness of PGL_2(q). Boundary cases n=2, odd n, and q=2 were checked against the hypotheses.

originality.rationale: Ma-Wang arXiv:2609.19546v1 constructs the subgroup but does not identify it as the normalizer or centralizer for the new even-n curves; it points only to the previously known odd-n full automorphism group. Exact and synonymous searches across Kummer/cyclic-cover normalizers, branch exponents, maximal curves, and PGL_2(q) found no prior statement implying the result. The source is extremely recent, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a sharp structural characterization of the entire known large automorphism subgroup: it is exactly the symmetry group preserving the Kummer structure. It reduces any remaining full-automorphism enlargement for even n to automorphisms moving the deck group to a distinct conjugate, separating the unresolved problem from further lifts over the same quotient.
